verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.lithic.com returning HTTP 200 with Lithic developer documentation content. First-party docs add agent-oriented access: assistants in Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot can search Lithic documentation through the official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of how complete and useful the llms.txt and agent-facing docs are in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
